key_quote: It logged me out three times and then locked my card, all before eight in the morning
If this branch goes I do not bank online, I just stop banking
After the third letter asking for the same papers I went to the fintech and was open in a day
I wanted to check a fee and the app made it feel like I had done something wrong
At midday we are two people and a queue, at ten in the morning we are five people and no customers
The money arrived eventually but for nine days we did not exist
The second person fixed it in one call, which makes you wonder about the first three weeks
The fee was six euros, the anger was that nobody had ever told me
Every time I sent a document it went into a tunnel, no receipt, no name, nothing
I do not mind waiting, I mind not knowing if I will be seen before the doors close
I sent the same extract twice, once as PDF once as a photo, nobody confirmed either
The system lets me close a case but not own one, there is a difference
It works fine for me, my problem is when it tells my father he is not himself
I know the rota is wrong, the queue knows the rota is wrong, only the rota does not know
The letter said no in three lines after five weeks of silence, that is not a decision, that is a door
Fourteen kilometres is nothing to a bank and everything to a seventy-year-old
The tariff PDF is thirty pages, I am a person not a compliance department
Each person was kind and each person started from zero, kindness without memory is just noise
Our accountant now keeps a Calder folder, a whole folder, just for re-sending things
Marta at the counter knows my name, that is the whole reason I am still here
The app is fine until something goes wrong, then there is nobody home
I can apologize in three languages but I cannot refund one euro without a form
Tuesdays I just come back another day, the queue is past the door
My relationship manager fought for us, I could hear it, but the machine does not fight back visibly
I can waive a fee in my head a hundred times a day, in the system never
The rota was written in 2017, the town has changed since then, the rota has not
Three verification apps to check one balance, I keep the branch number written down
When one person finally owned it, it took twenty minutes, that is the tragedy
Four people apologized and none of them could see what the last one had said
It is not the documents, it is being treated as suspicious by my own bank of fifteen years
